player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} aakar {max_rounds} round game Kuhn Poker re.
Game niyam:
- Kuhn Poker 3-card deck J, Q, K (J sabse niche, K sabse upar) ka use kare
- Pratyek player {ante} chip ante kare aur pratyek round 1 card paye (note ki card bina pratisthapana ke deal kiye jaye, isliye aapke paas aapke pratidwandi ki tarah ek hi card nahi ho sakta).
- Game {max_rounds} round tak chalta rahe
- Sabse adhik chip wale player sab round ke baad jeet jaye
Karya niyam:
- '[check]': Bina bet ke pass kare (keval yadi table par koi bet nahi hai)
- '[bet]': Pot mein 1 chip jode (keval yadi table par koi bet nahi hai)
- '[call]': Pratidwandi ki bet ka match kare aur pot mein 1 chip jode
- '[fold]': Apna haath chhod de aur pratidwandi ko pot jeetne dein
